source.origin: rtlscout benchmark fpmul_f16, https://github.com/huawei-csl/rtlscout (BSD-3-Clause-Clear): testbench and golden reference
source.design: IEEE binary16 multiplier with subnormal inputs and outputs, round to nearest even, canonical quiet NaN
source.starting_point: context/starting_point.v was written for this suite as a plain readable Verilog implementation; it is formally equivalent to golden/design.v (yosys-abc cec) and passes the testbench
source.golden: golden/design.v is rtlscout's reference (Spire HDL source compiled to Verilog); not shown to the agent, used by the equivalence check of every evaluation
source.testbench: tb.sv embeds the same reference and enumerates about 18.9M operand pairs (every subnormal/zero operand against structured partners, plus LFSR-driven broad pairs); no stimulus file
